objects.name: Backstory
objects.string: Hello coder, you're tasked with gaining reconnaissance on the villian group called the Power Blights. They have been going city to city and messing up codes in the power plants. You will gain the skills need to make correct conversions and bring the cities power back online. we will be intouch if you come across anything new. goodluck coder, we believe in you
